day25_retrospective_comparison.interpretation: The Day25 F3 positive-to-negative lexical/topic signature does not map uniformly to historically unstable lexical-label associations. Some terms rank highly, while several prominent energy/commodity terms are historically stable under the frozen Day26 estimator.

hypothesis_status.reason: Day26 constructs the historical predictor only. Future classification-error association is reserved for Day27.

primary_research_question: Do lexical features whose sentiment-label associations are unstable across historical time contribute to higher future classification error?
scientific_conclusion: Day26 successfully constructed and froze a reproducible historical-only lexical-label instability estimator. Historical lexical-label associations show heterogeneous temporal stability. The retrospective Day25 comparison shows only partial overlap between the previously observed F3 lexical/topic signature and historically unstable lexical-label associations. Day26 does not evaluate whether instability predicts future classification error; H1 remains untested until Day27.
scientific_objective: Construct and freeze a historical-only measure of temporal lexical-label instability for subsequent out-of-time evaluation.

support_qc.interpretation: The extreme instability tail is enriched for lower-support terms. This does not redefine the primary df>=20 ranking; the pre-registered df>=50 analysis remains secondary robustness evidence.

temporal_instability.definition: I(v)=max_c SD_t[A(v,c,t)], sample SD with ddof=1

vocabulary.primary_support_rule: historical df >= 20 and presence in >= 3 windows
